notes: Extends the existing capability/policy inventory pattern (JOV-5917: encode capabilities and policies, register instances, generic adapters) with writing coverage. This is a registry plus validator, not a new service.
Advisory transport is the artifact-bound Jev Gateway integration from JOV-6465 (scripts/invariants/jev-gateway.mjs, modality 'text'). No alternative HTTP adapter is created.
Whole-message generation that streams to a reader before any review is recorded as 'post-generation-advisory' review, never as gated.

The weekly advisory Slop Gate is retired: @jovie/copy owns copy rules (canon/VOICE.md) and the deterministic copy-gate ci-fast lane blocks new violations on changed customer-facing lines. This registry adds no recurring automation and no fleet dispatch.
Coverage reports a denominator and a reviewed version. There is no blanket 'everywhere' claim.
